Markets.title: Nasdaq rises 1%, Dow, S&P close higher as weak jobs data tempers rate hike bets
Markets.summary: U.S. stocks finished higher after a weaker-than-expected jobs report of 29,000 new nonfarm payrolls eased expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes. Despite these daily gains, the Dow and S&P 500 still recorded weekly declines.

Markets.title: Fed officials give hints on rate decision as markets cut October rate hike odds
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve officials Philip Jefferson and John Williams signaled a patient, data-dependent approach, reducing expectations for an October interest rate hike. Consequently, financial markets sharply lowered the odds of a rate increase, pending upcoming consumer price data and persistent inflation trends.

Markets.title: Why US stocks are rising: Nasdaq hits record after weaker jobs data cools rate-hike bets; Nike shares drop on forecast
Markets.summary: U.S. stocks rose and the Nasdaq hit a record high after weak jobs data lowered rate-hike expectations and Treasury yields declined. Meanwhile, Nike shares dropped following a forecast for a significant revenue decline due to challenges in China.

Markets.title: Sleepless on Wall Street: All-night stock exchanges coming soon
Markets.summary: Starting December 6, US stock exchanges will introduce an overnight trading session from 9 p.m. to 4 a.m. to attract foreign investors and compete with crypto markets. Institutional investors have raised concerns regarding potential market liquidity issues and increased risks during these hours.

Markets.title: Bets on US Federal Reserve rate hike in October fall as job market cools
Markets.summary: US job growth slowed to 29,000 last month and unemployment rose to 4.2%, falling short of economist expectations. Consequently, traders lowered the probability of an October Federal Reserve interest rate hike to under 20%.

Markets.title: Nike's struggles test investor confidence in CEO Hill's turnaround effort
Markets.summary: Nike's declining revenue and worsening profit projections are testing investor confidence in CEO Elliott Hill's turnaround strategy. Despite efforts to rebuild retail relationships, the company is cutting jobs and facing ongoing performance issues.

Geo-Political.title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
Geo-Political.summary: Riot police clashed with students in France during ongoing protests regarding educational standards and teacher shortages. More than 600 schools have experienced disruptions as a result of these demonstrations.

Geo-Political.title: Woman at centre of Cornell rape inquiry was 'failed' by officials, says New York governor
Geo-Political.summary: New York's governor stated that university officials failed a woman who alleges she was raped by seven students at a Cornell fraternity in 2024. The case is currently the subject of a Cornell rape inquiry.

Geo-Political.title: 'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot
Geo-Political.summary: Captain Smit Machchhar told Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi about opening his cockpit door to let others in during a co-pilot attack on a Flydubai flight. The pilot stated his action was intended to prevent others from dying.

Geo-Political.title: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
Geo-Political.summary: Kyiv Mayor Vitaliy Klitschko warns that intensified Russian strikes are devastating the Ukrainian capital's critical infrastructure. He describes the current situation in the city as very dramatic.

Geo-Political.title: Spanish PM Sánchez loses key housing crisis vote after eviction of woman, 87
Geo-Political.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez lost a crucial parliamentary vote on the housing crisis following public backlash over the eviction of an 87-year-old woman. This defeat increases political pressure on Sánchez to call a snap election amid a series of scandals involving his party and allies.

Geo-Political.title: I've seen nearly 500 executions - but never one like Christa Pike's
Geo-Political.summary: Veteran Texas reporter Michael Graczyk has witnessed nearly 500 executions throughout his career. However, he has never seen an execution where an inmate survived, such as the case of Christa Pike.

Data & Insights.summary: The G7 has released 100 million barrels from emergency reserves in response to tightening global oil supplies. National governments and international agencies control these strategic reserves and decide when to release them based on supply disruptions.

Data & Insights.title: Forex reserves plunge record $18.3 billion as RBI steps in to support rupee
Data & Insights.summary: India's forex reserves dropped by a record $18.34 billion to $747.56 billion during the week ending September 25. The decline occurred as the Reserve Bank of India intervened in the market to support the rupee.

Data & Insights.title: Diesel Diplomacy! Trump says Europe will release ‘massive amount’ of diesel as China cuts fuel exports
Data & Insights.summary: Donald Trump announced that Europe will release massive diesel reserves to ease supply pressures. This move comes as China restricts its fuel exports, compounding global market disruptions.

Data & Insights.title: India to face tougher competition for gas this winter? Here's what expert said
Data & Insights.summary: India may face higher liquefied natural gas (LNG) costs and tougher competition from Europe this winter. This is due to supply disruptions from Qatar tightening the global gas market.

Data & Insights.title: Hormuz crude flows return to pre-war levels, yet oil may still stay at $90–$100 | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: Crude oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz have returned to a pre-war average of 13.5 million barrels per day. Despite this recovery, oil prices may stay between $90 and $100 because refined-fuel supplies remain low.

Data & Insights.title: US 10-year yield jumps to 5.34% as global bond rout pushes borrowing costs higher
Data & Insights.summary: Global bond markets suffered heavy selling, driving the US 10-year yield up to 5.34% and pushing borrowing costs to multi-decade highs. Although bargain hunters temporarily stabilized the market, analysts warn that surging inflation and energy costs could trigger further declines.

India.summary: An Omani co-pilot stabbed Captain Smit Machchhar during a Flydubai flight on Wednesday. Following the incident, an Israeli minister called for naming a lounge at the main airport after Captain Machchhar.

India.title: Two Definitions Of Poverty In Jammu And Kashmir Fuel A Row Over Job Quotas
India.summary: Conflicting poverty definitions in Jammu and Kashmir have sparked a political controversy regarding job quotas. Local leaders allege that these discrepancies prevent impoverished residents in the Valley from obtaining Economically Weaker Section certificates.

India.title: Top Court Appoints Single-Judge Panel To Verify Genuine Noida Flat Claimants
India.summary: India's top court appointed a single-judge panel to verify genuine flat claimants in Noida. This follows a 2022 directive for the Noida authority to allot flats to 844 society members and examine claims from 133 subsequent purchasers.

India.title: "New Hero": Israeli Envoy Puts Up Billboard In Mumbai Praising flydubai Pilot
India.summary: An Israeli envoy put up a billboard in Mumbai praising a flydubai pilot as a "new hero." This came after the pilot's Dubai-to-Tel Aviv flight experienced an emergency and rapidly descended over 17,000 feet before safely diverting to Saudi Arabia.

India.title: 2 Arrested For Fake Social Media Posts Triggering Punjab University Protest
India.summary: Police arrested two individuals for spreading fake social media posts that triggered a student protest at Punjab University. Investigators identified the suspects after examining online activity and messages circulated by troublemakers during the unrest.

General.summary: U.S. murderer Christa Pike is currently unconscious and on a ventilator in a Nashville hospital following a failed execution. Her lawyers stated that she remained critically ill as of Thursday night.
